chunk_map.heading: Future leadership is about strategy, outcomes and customers

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8: "each of the three of you" is the closest call. Harm (referent never named) absent: the room is the trio, the preceding slide in apt101-three-jobs-rewritten is titled 'What each of us is for', and the training's own spine vocabulary is carved out. 'Strategy/Outcomes/Customers' named at L6 before 'That is leadership' at L8 resolves in-chunk.
grep for 'opening|earlier slide|lecture said|previous' in body_numbered: 0 pointers to another file by position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8 'A team lead whose week went into coordinating the build' is a generic role, not 'the X you did/saw'; no beat is referenced.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: three paragraphs, each self-carrying; closest is L8 'keeping the team's choices clear enough that people and agents can act on them', which states a claim on its own.

L1 header 'Future leadership is about strategy, outcomes and customers' vs L6 'Strategy... Outcomes... Customers' - body names exactly the three; closest strain is L4 (rationing) which sets up the contrast, not a contradiction.

L6 'Strategy: ... Outcomes: ... Customers: ...' is the nearest to a triplet but each leg carries distinct concrete content (a year's outcome, a behaviour change, first-hand words); no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.', no superlatives, no number retraction; L4 'rationing' is a concrete image. Em-dash grep 0, banned words grep 0.

rules_evaluated.evidence: grep banned/dialect (ritual, leverage, the student, session biography): 0 hits CLEAN. L4 'rationing capacity' is ordinary management language, not repo dialect.
